name: Lights Out
hook: Find the fuses. Don’t get caught.
how: The power is out. Search the dark building for the fuses with your flashlights and carry them to the breaker. Something is hunting you: it hears footsteps and sees flashlights. If it catches you, a teammate can get you back up.
controls: WASD to walk, mouse to aim the flashlight, Shift to run, F for the flashlight, or the touch stick and buttons
uses: The host's browser places the fuses, moves the monster and decides who gets caught; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
AI teammates search, fetch fuses and revive you until friends join.
Each run starts, ends and restarts together for everyone.
ideas: Add lockers you can hide in
Make the flashlight batteries run out
Add a second monster on hard mode
